issues.description: SPARQL constraint for draught limit does not declare the PREFIX nltl, causing unknown namespace error.
issues.suggestion: Add a PREFIX declaration for the nltl namespace inside the SPARQL query, e.g. `PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>` before the SELECT block, or ensure the SHACL engine resolves document‑level prefixes for SPARQL constraints.
